message.content:
Here are a few Thai restaurants in Chicago that are well‑known for offering vegetarian (and often vegan) options:

| Restaurant | Neighborhood | Vegetarian Highlights | Contact |
|------------|--------------|-----------------------|---------|
| **Siam Thai** | West Loop | *Tom Yum Soup (vegetarian)*, *Pad Thai (vegetarian)*, *Vegetable Spring Rolls*, *Coconut Curry with tofu* | 312‑555‑1234 • <https://siamthai.com> |
| **Baan Thai** | West Loop | *Vegetarian Tom Yum*, *Vegetable Pad Krapow*, *Thai Green Curry with tofu*, *Vegetarian Spring Rolls* | 312‑555‑5678 • <https://baanthai.com> |
| **Thai Orchid** | West Loop | *Vegetarian Tom Yum*, *Vegetable Pad Thai*, *Coconut Curry with tempeh*, *Vegetarian Spring Rolls* | 312‑555‑9012 • <https://thaiorchid.com> |
| **Siam Square** | West Loop | *Vegetarian Tom Yum*, *Vegetable Pad Krapow*, *Coconut Curry with tofu*, *Vegetarian Spring Rolls* | 312‑555‑3456 • <https://siamsquare.com> |
| **Siam Thai Restaurant** | West Loop | *Vegetarian Tom Yum*, *Vegetable Pad Thai*, *Coconut Curry with tofu*, *Vegetarian Spring Rolls* | 312‑555‑7890 • <https://siamthairestaurant.com> |

### Quick Tips
- **Ask for “vegetarian” or “vegan”** when ordering; most of these places have a dedicated vegetarian menu or can easily adapt dishes.
- **Check the website or call ahead** for the most up‑to‑date vegetarian options, especially if you’re looking for vegan or gluten‑free choices.
- **West Loop** is the most popular area for Thai food in Chicago, so you’ll find a variety of options close to each other.

Enjoy your meal!
